features: 5W Portable Bluetooth Wireless Speaker: Experience powerful sound with 5 watts of output, perfect for playing your favorite music, podcasts, or audiobooks without the hassle of wires
TWS Function (True Wireless Stereo): Pair two Hammer Drop speakers together for a richer, more immersive audio experience creating a stereo sound effect effortlessly
Twin Pairing: Connect two speakers with twin pairing for stereo sound and enhance your sound experience
FM Radio with Bluetooth Speaker: Enjoy listening to your favorite radio stations directly from the wireless speaker & stay connected to live broadcasts without needing an additional device

Wireless Spreaker Supports TF Card and USB Slot: Play music directly from a TF (microSD) card or USB drive, offering flexible playback options for all your favorite tracks without needing a separate device
Auto-Pairing: Enjoy the convenience of auto-pairing, where the bluetooth speaker automatically reconnects to the last used device, saving your time and hassle with every use
Bluetooth Speaker with Mic In-Built: Take hands-free calls with the in-built microphone, ensuring clear and convenient communication without needing to reach for your phone
32 Hours Playtime: Enjoy up to 32 hours of continuous playtime on a single charge ideally suitable for parties, trips, or any time you need extended listening
Type-C Charging: Quickly recharge your mini bluetooth speaker with the modern and efficient Type-C charging port, ensuring faster and more reliable power delivery

100H Standby Time: With an impressive 100hr standby time, this speaker is always ready to play whenever you are. 1200 mAh Battery: Enjoy long-lasting battery life with a 1200 mAh capacity, ensuring hours of entertainment without needing frequent recharges

Portable : The Hammer Drop 5 W Portable Bluetooth Wireless Speaker is designed to deliver powerful sound in a compact and travel-friendly design. With 5 W audio output, this speaker produces clear vocals, balanced mids, and punchy bass—perfect for enjoying music, podcasts, audiobooks, or calls without the clutter of wires

1200 mAh Battery, 100 Hrs StandBy Time, 32 Hrs Playtime : Powered by a 1200 mAh battery, the Hammer Drop offers long-lasting performance with up to 32 hours of playtime on a single charge and an impressive 100 hours of standby time, ensuring your speaker is always ready when you need it
